note: AIB's guide to fees and charges for personal accounts: a personal current account's monthly account fee is 6 euros, covering unlimited euro transactions; none for an AIB mortgage holder paying it from the account (not modelled). Debit-card stamp duty isn't modelled. Read again 2026-10-30: the monthly fee covers unlimited euro transactions, taking cash out among them (own and other machines free); unpaid items carry no charge; a purchase in another currency costs 1.75% of the euro value (at least 0.45, at most 11.00 EUR, bounds the form's card share doesn't hold); cash taken out abroad 2.5% plus a commission of 1% at least 2.00 and at most 6.00 EUR, written as 3.5% (exact between 200 and 600 EUR, under it below 200 and over it above 600). An overdraft is by agreement only, its rate in the agreement, with a facility fee of 25.39 EUR (not written). Not stated: interest, transfers' prices, what opening asks.

sources.title: AIB, A guide to fees and charges for personal accounts
